greeting: ^Yar! Good news! I’ve found a sliver of a ship here! We're on the way to building a grand vessel!
^Aye, the waves here are always going to be rough, but that be the challenge for a true pirate!
^I’ve picked up some tricks along the way tho! When the waves are tough, I try to breathe along with the tide!
^Breathe in like the ship going up, right to the top! Breathing out while ye descend. It be like yer one with the waves.
farewell: ^That's the spirit! Keep remindin' yerself of that.
^Yer a chip off the old block, ye'll make a great pirate in no time. Good luck, Captain!
